purpose: Current Python HTTP route inventory with bounded Supabase foundation/model coverage; live production parity requires separate deployment evidence.

semantics.HEAD: HEAD maps to GET except page SSE dispatch requires actual GET. Each supported HEAD is explicit.
semantics.OPTIONS: No general legacy CORS route: only SCIM ServiceProviderConfig accepts OPTIONS through its early unconditional response. Cloud preflight is a new boundary, not migrated legacy business coverage.
semantics.pathAliases: Segment-based routes strip outer slashes and may tolerate trailing slash; exact routes do not. Advanced suffix aliases remain only for collections whose Authorization.prepare allows them; members/groups reject extra segments and unsupported verbs before Advanced dispatch for every base role. Admin routes use exact equality/anchored fullmatch and reject trailing/suffix aliases.
semantics.publication: public=true means anonymous HTTP boundary, not merely a published-content feature; published pages/forms currently retain session authentication in family/accounts mode.
semantics.authorization: All business routes use fresh original session, Authorization.prepare/project and domain checks; SCIM uses a separate configured bearer + service owner.
semantics.cloud: cloud.status records this inventory's unconfigured createBackend foundation fixture or the listed staged contracts, not the current deployed application state. createApplication installs domain handlers. Production-parity-verified remains false here; /health readiness and actual deployments have separate evidence.
semantics.adminContentExport: GET/HEAD /api/admin/content/export uses optional exactly-once format=raw|frames, defaults raw, and strips format before search-query normalization/cursor binding. No new path or verb. Other content endpoints retain strict queries. Framed NDJSON uses explicit complete/error terminal records; actual transport/consumer behavior is verified separately from this read-only AST route inventory.
